# Versions of: Newsrooms on open data

1 published version of [Newsrooms on open data: turning the public data feeds behind PrompTugal.news and the Storm Charles site into one data site, a vault per source with an API and its provenance, then building small, focused newsrooms on top, for farmers, investors, the sea, fire, tourism and AI, each run by an agentic team, each a possible company, and why this is exactly where journalism comes in](../newsrooms-on-open-data.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
